## What changed

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the commands or manual checks you ran and their results. For UI changes, include desktop/mobile screenshots when useful.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the behavior changed, or I explained why tests are unnecessary.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass locally (`make check`; see `CONTRIBUTING.md`).
- [ ] Protocol, config, and setup docs are updated if their behavior changed.
- [ ] No credentials, raw data, model checkpoints, or unlicensed audio are included.

## Deployment notes

Mention required config, data, migrations, or rollback steps. Write "None" if there are none.
